notes.title: Game release date
notes.notes:
Hello cyclists, gamers.
For a long time there was no news about the process of development of the game, some thought that the project was frozen, but no development of the game continued, but changes in the world have made adjustments and the development process was delayed.
Here is the [b]official game trailer[/b]:
[previewyoutube=wbDxV4nHqkY;full][/previewyoutube]
When I started the game, I wanted to make a relaxing game where you can relax on your bike and enjoy the beauty of nature with a nice ambient sounds. I really hope that you enjoy the game and that you can have a good time cycling. 

The main goal of the game is to overcome the track by controlling the bike, crashing into an obstacle you fall off the bike and start your way from the last control point, along the way you collect coins, and if you want to explore the map in detail, you can open [b]hidden characters[/b], but be careful, some to reach very difficult. After completing the passage of the track, you can move on to the next or try to pass the track again in a shorter time to get to the leaderboard. With the collected coins you can unlock new bikes, colors, and new characters. 
It's up to you to pass the course in the best time, or to slowly explore each section of the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936896/20c81854bc1fbb8210ef8feb2aa0b3d16c03108c.png[/img]

At the time of [b]release 5 maps[/b] will be available, but if the public likes the game, then every month for a year I will release one new map, all maps will be available for free. I really hope you enjoy the game and add it to your library. I will be glad if you leave positive feedback, it will help me a lot in developing this game and my next projects. 
I develop all my projects [b]alone[/b], and if you've ever been involved in game development, you'll understand how hard it is to make games alone, so I'll be glad to have your support and advice. Unfortunately my current income doesn't allow me to expand my little studio, but I always believe in the best) 

If you have any suggestions, tips, or find bugs during the game, please let me know and I will fix them. You can contact me via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1903400/discussions/0/3457093950206589110/]discussions[/url], [url=https://discord.com/invite/KBKpT3jW5x]discord[/url] or e-mail.

Furthermore, don’t forget to add Bicycle Rider Simulator to your wishlist. 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903400/Bicycle_Rider_Simulator/

Best Regards,
DiamosDev
